translation: Flavor sour, slightly cold, slightly poisonous. Its chief actions are to course and free the blood vessels, relax the center, disperse foul blood, drive out robber blood (賊血), dispel water qi, benefit the bladder and large and small intestines, dissipate abscesses and swellings, seasonal chills and fever, attack by noxious qi, abdominal pain, and lumbar pain. One name is 白 [芍].
